# RecallDB — Official U.S. Product Recall Database

> RecallDB is a normalized, provenance-tracked dataset of 127,783 official U.S. federal product recall records covering 292,790 linked recalled products across five federal sources: CPSC consumer products, FDA/openFDA plus FDA Safety Alerts, USDA FSIS food safety, NHTSA vehicles, and USCG recreational boating. Every row is 100% source-linked, carrying its agency ID, record URL, source endpoint, retrieval timestamp, and SHA-256 raw-payload fingerprint. A public CC0 sample and documentation are free; the full CSV + SQLite export is paid and privately delivered.

## Core Capabilities & Specs
- **Data Formats:** CSV and SQLite (full dataset); CSV (public sample)
- **Data Sources:** CPSC (8,179), FDA/openFDA + FDA Safety Alerts (86,476), NHTSA (30,143), USDA FSIS (1,222), USCG (1,763)
- **Attribution:** Public sample released under CC0 1.0 Universal. Source records originate from official U.S. federal government publications (public domain). Attribution to the publishing agencies and RecallDB is appreciated for auditability.
- **Licensing Tiers:**
  - Full Dataset Snapshot — $49 one-time, CSV + SQLite with provenance ledger and source links: https://buy.stripe.com/aFacN69Jm2MK8rN5Uk38408
  - Enterprise Custom Request — $99+ custom joins, refresh cadence, retail/SKU matching, enrichment, or schema work; request via https://recalldb.dataengineered.io/#pricing or email recalldb.shorthand343@aleeas.com
